exposure: Maternal feelings about pregnancy (indifferent vs. happy)
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcomes (including neonatal death, APGAR score at five minutes <7, low birth weight <2.5 kg)
cohort: The study included all teenagers (13-19 years) who delivered at a tertiary referral hospital in southwestern Uganda and were in the postnatal ward.
finding: Nearly half of teenage mothers experienced adverse perinatal outcomes, with a history of prior miscarriage significantly increasing the odds and ANC attendance being mildly protective.
cross-section timing: Data was collected in the postnatal ward after delivery.
